kwintenlulay_: Yann Kwintenlulay joined the replacements on Day 5. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. The transfer made Yann Kwintenlulay a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Yann Kwintenlulay cut Gideon "Whistle" Vylet's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.
pavla.9_: Karel Pavla found a place in R-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Volunteer number 68. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Karel Pavla's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Orders came through: Karel Pavla is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a tin whistle.
A bullet clipped Karel Pavla's helmet at R-F10 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Karel Pavla is whole again, or near enough for the line. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel Pavla let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel Pavla and Albin "Tin" Shoes compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

Karel Pavla pulled Oskar Eddie out of a flooded shell hole at the Sunken Road. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.
Karel Pavla went out with the wiring party at R-F10. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
seal.ingfan: Jakub "Brick" Ingfan arrived on Day 3 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A clear shot from R-F19. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan grazed Felix Landon and slid back down below the parapet. The transfer made Jakub "Brick" Ingfan a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The dugout roof dripped into Jakub "Brick" Ingfan's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.
superfeisty7: On the way to R-F9, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
One of the first hundred, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty and Isidor Glc made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.

A section of parapet collapsed near Rafael "Button" Superfeisty. The repairs began as soon as the dust settled, with one man watching while the others worked. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty fixed the strap on Pavel Mvuisak's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac held the mirror while Rafael "Button" Superfeisty shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
